# Kenney Fonts (CC0)

Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/kenney-fonts
Fonts by Kenney (www.kenney.nl).

The fonts are public domain (CC0). Credit is appreciated but not required. The original notice is in `LICENSE-original.txt`.

Only the fonts this game uses are kept: Kenney Pixel Square (display) and Kenney Mini Square (body). `scripts/make_fonts.py` turns the first two into Forge font atlases.
